_why: Official InferSports endpoint/documentation could not be verified from this environment (only third-party directory listings were found).
infersports.com and api.infersports.com are refused by this environment's egress proxy (HTTP 403 on CONNECT).
_how_to_enable: 1. Obtain the endpoint URL from InferSports' own documentation and verify it.
2. Confirm every exposed tool is read-only (live scores, schedule, historical/current odds, de-vigged probabilities).
3. Copy the 'mcpServers' block below into the project .mcp.json with the verified URL.
4. Keep the permissions allow-list limited to read tools; this lab never places real bets.
